caption:
US B1/B2 interview from Dubai: it is short, and that is exactly why it is hard.

Officers assess one thing — whether your life is anchored outside the United States. For a Dubai resident, that anchor is here: your job, your residence, your family, your commitments.

Answer directly. Do not over-explain. Do not volunteer what was not asked. And make sure your documents support exactly what you say.

slides.headline: TO ANSWER WELL
items: Answer the question asked — then stop
Do not volunteer information nobody requested
Be specific about what you return to in the UAE

slides.headline: THEY ARE ASKING WHERE YOUR LIFE IS.
slides.sub: For you, the answer is Dubai.

slides.headline: HOW APPLICANTS LOSE IT
slides.never: Over-explain, volunteer information nobody asked for, and rehearse a script that stops sounding like a person. Officers interview all day; they notice.
slides.instead: Answer the question asked, then stop. Know your own file well enough that you do not need a script.
